annotations.title: Check every citation in a document

description: Checks the case citations in a document the user supplies (a draft filing, brief or motion) against this collection and court-reported negative history, showing which cited cases to read before filing. Nothing is ever cleared: there is no pass mark or "verified" state. Per citation: reported_negative_history (a later opinion’s sentence matched as reporting it overruled, abrogated, superseded, reversed or vacated, in records[].reported_by; unverified, with known false positives), no_row_found (nothing found, not a clearance), not_in_collection (echoed as written, never corrected or remapped). Short forms (Id., supra, bare names) are counted in short_form_counts, not checked; statutes, rules and secondary sources are not checked. quotes[]: quoted words near a citation compared with the stored text, status found (pin cite and support not checked), not_found_in_stored_text (with stored_passage and agrees_for_words; not a finding of invention), no_text_stored or not_checked; block quotations are not checked; the join is a nearest-neighbour guess (attribution_method, attribution_distance). protected_info: a pattern scan for identifiers court rules bar from public filings (Fed. R. Civ. P. 5.2(a), Kan. S. Ct. R. 24(b)), values masked, with category, rule_refs and offsets; a finding is not a ruling, zero findings is not a clearance, and not_detectable lists what it cannot see. Bounds: 200 citations, 25 detailed flags (flagged_without_detail), citations_truncated, multiple_records, zero_result_detail. The document is not stored or logged. Negative-history limits are those of the treatment tool. Case law in this mirror ends 2026-09-30 (exact scan of all 10,174,547 case records): a thin or empty result for recent authority means the collection ends there, not that no such case exists. Every response carries a "headline", a "note" and a coverage_note. The sources tool returns this tool’s full coverage statement.

text.description: the document text to check, as plain text. Up to 380,000 characters; a longer document is refused with a reason rather than silently cut, because a check run on part of a filing says nothing about the rest
